title: Field Guide: Conversation Rescue & Repair Loops

words.English Meaning: did not understand / didn't catch that
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 不好意思，我刚才没听懂。(Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ gāngcái méi tīngdǒng.) — Sorry, I didn't understand just now.
信号不太好，请再说一遍。(Xìnhào bú tài hǎo, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.) — Bad signal, please say that one more time.
我的中文不太好，请说慢一点。(Wǒ de zhōngwén bú tài hǎo, qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎnr.) — My Chinese isn't great, please speak slower.
请问这个用中文怎么说？(Qǐngwèn zhè ge yòng zhōngwén zěnme shuō?) — Excuse me, how do you say this in Chinese?
可以麻烦您帮我写下来吗？(Kěyǐ máfan nín bāng wǒ xiě xiàlái ma?) — Could you please write that down for me?
可以打字给我看一下吗？(Kěyǐ dǎzì gěi wǒ kàn yíxià ma?) — Could you type it on your phone so I can see?

words.English Meaning: do you mean... / your meaning is
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 你的意思是明天不上课，对吗？(Nǐ de yìsi shì míngtiān bú shàngkè, duì ma?) — Your meaning is there's no class tomorrow, right?
我想表达，但不知道怎么说。(Wǒ xiǎng biǎodá, dàn bù zhīdào zěnme shuō.) — I want to express it, but don't know how to say it.

words.Pinyin: yí jù yí jù de shuō
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 可以一句一句地说吗？(Kěyǐ yí jù yí jù de shuō ma?) — Could you go sentence by sentence?

words.English Meaning: how do you spell it (in pinyin)?
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请问这个字怎么拼？(Qǐngwèn zhè ge zì zěnme pīn?) — Excuse me, how is this character spelled?
请问这个词是什么意思？(Qǐngwèn zhè ge cí shì shénme yìsi?) — What does this vocabulary word mean?
环境有点吵，我没听清楚。(Huánjìng yǒudiǎnr chǎo, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu.) — It's noisy here, I didn't hear clearly.
谢谢你的耐心解释，我现在懂了。(Xièxie nǐ de nàixīn jiěshì, wǒ xiànzài dǒng le.) — Thanks for your patient explanation, I get it now.
你是说九点半在大门见，对吗？(Nǐ shì shuō jiǔ diǎn bàn zài dàmén jiàn, duì ma?) — You said meet at 9:30 at the gate, right?
走得太快了，等等我！(Zǒu de tài kuài le, děngděng wǒ!) — You're walking too fast, wait for me!
请稍等一下，我查一下地图。(Qǐng shāoděng yíxià, wǒ chá yíxià dìtú.) — Just a moment, let me check the map.
听不懂的时候可以用手势比划。(Tīng bù dǒng de shíhou kěyǐ yòng shǒushì bǐhua.) — When you don't understand, you can gesture.
请在菜单上指一下你想要的菜。(Qǐng zài càidān shang zhǐ yíxià nǐ xiǎng yào de cài.) — Please point to the dish you want on the menu.
我的发音对不对？(Wǒ de fāyīn duì bu duì?) — Is my pronunciation correct?
不好意思，麻烦再说一次。(Bù hǎoyìsi, máfan zài shuō yí cì.) — Excuse me, please say it one more time.
每天听中文播客可以提高听力。(Měitiān tīng zhōngwén bōkè kěyǐ tígāo tīnglì.) — Listening to Chinese podcasts daily improves listening skills.
老师把刚才的重点重复了一遍。(Lǎoshī bǎ gāngcái de zhòngdiǎn chóngfù le yí biàn.) — The teacher repeated the key point just mentioned.
现在声音非常清楚了。(Xiànzài shēngyīn fēicháng qīngchu le.) — The audio is very clear now.
